qs.q: A medical student is reviewing the contents of the femoral sheath from a lateral to medial orientation. Using the mnemonic NAVEL, what structure immediately lies medial to the femoral vein?
qs.e: Within the femoral sheath, the arrangement from lateral to medial is artery, vein, and the empty space of the femoral canal containing fat and lymphatics. The femoral nerve lies outside the sheath laterally.
qs.s: Abdominal Wall Hernias: Anatomy, Types, Complications and Repair: MCQs
